landed-0.text: Apollo 11 landed at Tranquility Base in 1969.

first-step-0.text: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin explored the Moon.

hop-0.text: The Moon's gravity is about one sixth of Earth's.

bootprint-0.text: No wind blows the astronauts' footprints away.

columbia-0.text: Michael Collins stayed in lunar orbit aboard Columbia.

flag-rocks-0.text: Apollo 11 brought Moon rocks and soil home.

experiments-0.text: Astronauts deployed a seismometer and laser retroreflector.

plaque-0.text: A plaque on the descent stage commemorates the landing.

liftoff-0.text: The ascent stage carried Neil and Buzz back to lunar orbit.

today-0.text: Scientists measure the Moon's distance using laser retroreflectors.
